_comment: Copy to either location — both are read and MERGED, with the workspace file
winning when the same server id appears in both:
That is the useful split: shared servers global, project-specific servers
type is stdio, sse, or http. stdio requires command; sse and http require url.
$VAR and ${VAR} are expanded in command, args, env values, and url, against
the process environment plus ${WORKSPACE_ROOT}, which resolves to the
workspace directory for the run. Reference secrets that way instead of
writing them into a file you check in.
Run /mcp in the TUI to see connected servers and their status.
Remove this _comment key before use — it is documentation, not config.
